_note: Sample main-chat answers and their Cave Talk translations for the mockups. Cave text is meant to be funny, not useful.

samples.user: why does my pod keep restarting
samples.chat:
Your pod is in **CrashLoopBackOff**. The container starts, exceeds its memory limit, and is **OOMKilled**. The JVM heap is set to `-Xmx2g`, but the container limit is `1Gi`, so the kernel kills it as soon as the heap grows. Kubernetes restarts it with exponential backoff: 10s, 20s, 40s, up to 5 minutes.

**Fix:** raise `resources.limits.memory` to `2.5Gi`, or lower the heap to `-Xmx768m` so it fits.
cave: Little box wake up. Little box eat. Little box eat **too much mammoth**. Little box fall down.
Big Boss Rock pick box up. Box eat. Box fall. Boss Rock wait longer. Then longer. Then LONGER. Boss Rock very patient. Box very dumb.
Box belly fit **one mammoth**. Box try eat **two mammoth**. Math not work.
**Fix:** bigger belly. Or smaller mammoth. Me choose bigger belly. Me always choose bigger belly.

samples.chat: Requests to `api.internal` fail with `NXDOMAIN`. CoreDNS forwards to `10.0.0.2`, a resolver that was decommissioned last week. Point the `forward` directive in the `coredns` ConfigMap at the new resolver (`10.0.4.10`) and roll the CoreDNS pods.
cave: Everybody want go Api Cave. Nobody know where Api Cave is.
Name Rock supposed to know. Name Rock ask Old Wise Rock. Old Wise Rock gone. Retire. Live by lake now. Very happy.
**Fix:** tell Name Rock about New Wise Rock. Then shake Name Rock little bit.
It always Name Rock. ALWAYS. Me say this before. Nobody listen to caveman.

samples.chat: Merge conflict in `deploy/values.yaml`: your branch sets `replicas: 3`, `main` sets `replicas: 5`. Choose one, delete the `<<<<<<<`, `=======` and `>>>>>>>` markers, then `git add` the file and `git rebase --continue`.
cave: Two caveman paint same wall. Same spot. Same day.
One paint **3 mammoth**. Other paint **5 mammoth**. Wall confused. Wall grow angry lines: `<<<<<<<`
You pick how many mammoth. Wipe angry lines. Tell wall "is fine."
Me say paint 4 mammoth. Everybody little bit sad. Tribe call this "compromise."

samples.user: memory keeps climbing on the worker
samples.chat: Heap grows about 50 MB an hour because a new `message` listener is attached on every request and never removed. Detach it in a `finally` block, or register it with `{ once: true }`.
cave: Every time friend visit, program pick up rock. Program never put rock down.
Pocket full of rock. Program walk slow. Program fall in river.
**Fix:** when friend leave, put rock down.
Rock not friend. Rock just rock. Program must learn this.

samples.user: inventory count is off under load
samples.chat: Two workers read the same `count` before either writes, so one decrement is lost. Use an atomic update (`UPDATE stock SET count = count - 1 WHERE id = $1`) or lock the row with `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`.
cave: Two caveman see one mammoth leg. Both grab. Same time. Leg rip.
Each caveman think he have whole leg. Both wrong. Both hungry. Both angry at leg.
**Fix:** one caveman grab. Other caveman wait.
Waiting hard. Me know. Me terrible at waiting.

Shell counting hard. Shell round. Number not round.
Me bonk shell rock.

samples.chat: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')`. `user` is `undefined` once the session expires. Guard with `if (!user) return redirect('/login')` before reading `user.id`.
cave: You point at rock. You say "look, rock." No rock there.
Program look where you point. Program see nothing. Program scream: WHERE ROCK.
**Fix:** check rock exist. Then point at rock. In that order.

samples.chat: The `while (retries < max)` loop never increments `retries` on the timeout path, so it spins forever. Increment it in the `catch` block.
cave: Caveman walk around tree. Look for end of tree. Tree round.
Caveman still walking. Caveman tired. Caveman not stop. Caveman not know HOW stop.
**Fix:** count step. After ten step, sit down. Eat snack.

samples.chat: The browser blocks the request because the API doesn't return `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` for `https://app.example.com`. Add that origin to the API's CORS allowlist.
cave: Cave A want talk Cave B. Guard at Cave B say: "Who you? No note from chief." Cave A cry.
**Fix:** chief of Cave B write note: "Cave A okay." Nail note to door.
Guard read note. Guard let talk. Guard still suspicious. Guard always suspicious. Good guard.
